goals: Replace the ordinary survival inventory's built-in 2×2 crafting matrix with permanent 3×3 crafting through Minecraft's existing recipe, result, remainder, recipe-book, and server-authoritative menu systems.
Preserve crafting tables and the validated Inventory Extended, Simple Trash Slot, Trinkets, JEI, equipment, hotbar, routing, and lifecycle boundaries.
scope: Modify only InventoryMenu with one nine-cell TransientCraftingContainer and the index-preserving row-major public menu order [1, 2, 74, 3, 4, 75, 76, 77, 78].
Retain the appended-input quick-move path, recipe-book placement, JEI InventoryMenu transfer adapter, Creative mutation guards, nine player.crafting entity ranges, and client/server slot parity.
Retain the self-contained Canary 4 inventory artwork and final coordinates: inputs at x 77,95,113 and y 8,26,44; result at 152,27; recipe-book button at 100,62.

exclusions: CraftingMenu, crafting-table placement and behavior, and Simple Portable Crafting remain unchanged.
Ordinary quick move, pickup, external-container routing, offhand routing, carried-container routing, and Trinkets operations must never use crafting cells as destinations.
Simple Trash Slot screen positioning remains owned by its existing configuration; this project owns only its preserved logical/menu compatibility.
Companion resource packs, pack-order changes, runtime deployment, accepted-stack mutation, Test Instance Manager mutation, and unrelated project work are outside this migration.

dependencies.reason: Target game version for the accepted InventoryMenu implementation and frozen vanilla contracts.
Required Java level for Minecraft 26.2 and the retained build.
Required Fabric API baseline declared by Canary 4.
Defines the accepted six-row inventory, hotbar, offhand, and appended-slot compatibility foundation.
Owns menu slot 73 and the configured upper-panel Trash position before the five appended crafting views.
The accepted layout preserves the dynamic Trinkets suffix after the 79-slot pre-Trinkets prefix.
Provides the exact player crafting transfer contract adapted by the retained JEI plugin.

state.milestone: C4 passed the final visual correction, preserves the focused functional runtime result, and is accepted client-side and in singleplayer.

current.summary: Replaces survival inventory crafting with a permanent server-authoritative 3×3 matrix.

accepted.summary: Replaces survival inventory crafting with a permanent server-authoritative 3×3 matrix.
